summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time latch in the rich progress module. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; Task.finished now derived from finished_time; Task._reset clears finished_time; Progress.update and Progress.advance capture elapsed once at completion inside the lock; Progress.reset clears finished_time), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), tests/test_progress.py (new unit test for TimeElapsedColumn; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns with hand-derived expected output), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry). Tests were not run, per instructions; the test_columns expected string was derived by hand from a MockClock trace and is unverified. Caveats: update(refresh=True) renders live elapsed once before capture; Task.visible is shifted positionally by the new finished_time field.
